Design QA — listings

Our page against the product's own render, region by region. Product page 1918px · ours 1900px.

This is a worklist, not a pass mark. A dev-mode React render and static HTML are never pixel-identical — synthesised font weights alone see to that. The percentages rank where to look. The one hard rule is the shell (rail, header, footer): identical markup on every page, so anything over 6% there is a real defect.
2 shell region(s) over threshold: shell.title, shell.header

2 · Off-scale sizes

Every font-size, weight, gap and padding the page computes, against the steps utils.less declares. A value not here had to be written as a literal.

Nothing to report.

Nothing to report.

px literals outside :root

A computed padding cannot be judged — the product's own 1em resolves to 14px and looks identical to a literal. A value written as px in a rule can be, and every one belongs in a token with its source beside it.

Nothing to report.

5 · Coverage

Regions the product's render has that our page never modelled. Not a score — a list of what we chose not to build, so a percentage can never quietly mean “of the part I listed”.
